steps.text:
The tests pass (2 passed). The fix in `dedupe.py` is already in place:

- `unique()` uses a `seen` list to track items already encountered
- It preserves first-occurrence order (e.g., `["b", "a", "b", "c"]` → `["b", "a", "c"]`)
- It works with unhashable items like dicts because it uses `in` (equality comparison) rather than a set (which requires hashing)
